title: AB 1592 · limited pilot project

title: DMV · formal regulatory proposal
summary: The DMV's April 25, 2025 formal proposal would repeal the ban on autonomous vehicles of 10,001 pounds or more and create a staged path for driverless heavy-duty truck testing and deployment on specified routes, excluding passenger, oversize, hazardous-materials and bulk-liquid operations. It also added reporting, including vehicle immobilizations, aligned crash reporting with NHTSA, and created enforcement short of permit suspension; comments closed June 9, 2025.

title: DMV · first modified proposal

Comments were open until December 18, 2025.
